assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Create the final standalone brand symbol for "Round QR Studio", an expressive yet extremely simple designer-quality monogram. Square 1024x1024 canvas, solid warm off-white #F7F8F2 background. One large centered near-black #171C13 circular Q mark: a thick almost-complete geometrically perfect circular band, open in the lower-right quadrant, and a single detached acid-lime #DFF86A rounded square nestled diagonally at 4:30 to complete the Q tail. The square is a QR module escaping the circle. Make the relationship between circular counter, intentional gap and square unmistakably read as a custom letter Q. Optical balance, confident thick weight, beautiful negative space. The lime square has a very thick near-black outline so it remains clear at favicon sizes. Mark occupies 72% of the canvas. Pure flat two-color vector-style geometry, precisely centered, no tiny modules, no conventional QR-code pictogram, no scan corner brackets, no additional typography, no shadows, no gradients, no textures, no mockups, no 3D. This is one final iconic brand mark, not a contact sheet.

Use case: compositing / ads-marketing
Asset: final Open Graph promotional cover for Round QR Studio, landscape 1200x630 / 1.905:1.
Input image 1 is an ACTUAL screenshot of our QR generator with demo Wi-Fi configuration: network Studio Guest, password Welcome2026, WPA / WPA2, Circle shape, dotted near-black modules on acid-lime. It is the authoritative product reference.
Input image 2 is the NEW authoritative logo: thick circular Q with an outlined acid-lime square at lower right.
Create a sophisticated minimal product advertisement from these assets. Warm very pale off-white background, near-black type, a restrained lime accent. At the upper left put a small exact copy of the new Q logo beside the wordmark "Round QR Studio". Beneath on the left, bold large editorial sans-serif headline across three lines: "Wi-Fi." / "One scan" / "away." At lower left add the smaller exact line "Create. Customize. Connect." Keep this text column around 33% of width.
On the right occupying around 63% width and most height show ONE crisp front-facing product window, gently rounded with a faint fine border and subtle shadow. Use the provided REAL screenshot, tightly cropped to remove its huge empty external margins. Focus the product window on the Wi-Fi selected tile, the actual network name and password inputs, WPA / WPA2 selection and the prominent lime circular QR preview. Keep real visible UI styling. The configuration and the actual generated circular QR should be clearly recognizable and readable. Preserve the screenshot's QR module pattern faithfully as an image; do NOT invent an abstract fake QR, warp it, obscure it, or place text over it. Real screenshot compositing is the point. You may crop below the shape options and remove the raw encoded payload row to keep the focus on the network and its QR. Do not include browser chrome, giant whitespace from original screenshot, the old header icon, bytes counter, irrelevant controls, extra device mockups, decorative floating cards, stock photography, gradients, extra symbols or watermarks. Maintain a tasteful clean grid, consistent margin 45px at 1200px width, balanced negative space, enough separation between headline and product. The result should feel like a premium product launch graphic, with actual UI as the hero. Accurate exact English spelling.
assets.copyEditPrompt:
Use case: text-localization
Make a targeted text-only edit to the supplied Round QR Studio OG marketing image. The product is an open source QR code generator; Wi-Fi is ONLY the example shown in its UI.
Replace the large LEFT headline with exactly:
"Open source"
"QR code"
"generator"
Use those three lines in bold near-black sans-serif, adjusting font size to fit the existing left column with comfortable margins. No punctuation, periods, bullets or hyphen between Open and source. All three lines should be readable and visually balanced.
Replace the small LEFT tagline with exactly "Create and customize your QR codes" in smaller readable sans-serif, wrapping into two lines if needed. No punctuation at the end.
Keep the logo and Round QR Studio wordmark, lime dash, off-white backdrop and entire RIGHT product screenshot unchanged, including UI labels, demo network Studio Guest and circular lime QR code. Do not recreate, rearrange, recolor or modify the QR pattern or the screenshot. Only replace the two left promotional text blocks. Maintain landscape 1200x630 aspect ratio and polished existing composition.

notes: The OG artwork was generated from a real local application screenshot using fictitious demo Wi-Fi credentials (Studio Guest / Welcome2026). The generated marketing rendition is not a QR export; use the application to export functional QR codes. Artwork resized for web delivery.
